articles.title: Sweaty Soccer Stars: Why the 2026 World Cup Might Be the Hottest Ever
articles.summary: Imagine playing soccer in a giant oven! Scientists say 1 in 4 World Cup games could be super hot, with temperatures feeling like 28°C or more. Players are already dousing themselves with water to cool down.

articles.title: Bye-Bye, Flat Bum? New Drug Might Help Keep Muscles Strong While Losing Weight
articles.summary: Some people taking weight-loss shots like Ozempic lose muscle, not just fat, leading to a saggy bum. A new drug called apitegromab helped people keep more muscle while still shedding pounds in a study.

articles.title: World Cup Workers Say: 'We Might Strike!' Here's Why
articles.summary: Workers at SoFi Stadium, where the first U.S. World Cup match will be played, voted 96% to strike. They want better pay and safety from immigration agents. Talks are still happening.
